description: This file defines the interface for the WiFiManager class, which manages WiFi functionalities such as scanning, connecting, disconnecting, and handling WiFi events within a plugin framework. It declares various methods, events, and internal components related to WiFi management in a plugin-based architecture.

classes.name: WiFiManager
classes.description: A plugin class that manages WiFi operations and events, inheriting plugin and JSON RPC interfaces to facilitate communication and control within the framework.

methods.name: WiFiManager
methods.description: Constructor for the WiFiManager class.

methods.name: ~WiFiManager
methods.description: Destructor for the WiFiManager class.

methods.name: getCurrentState
methods.description: Retrieves the current WiFi state and responds via JSON object.

methods.name: startScan
methods.description: Initiates a WiFi scan for available networks.

methods.name: stopScan
methods.description: Stops an ongoing WiFi scan.

methods.name: getConnectedSSID
methods.description: Retrieves the SSID of the currently connected network.

methods.name: setEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables the WiFi.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Connects to a specified WiFi network.

methods.name: disconnect
methods.description: Disconnects from the current WiFi network.

methods.name: initiateWPSPairing
methods.description: Starts WPS pairing process.

methods.name: cancelWPSPairing
methods.description: Cancels ongoing WPS pairing.

methods.name: saveSSID
methods.description: Saves WiFi network SSID.

methods.name: clearSSID
methods.description: Clears stored SSID information.

methods.name: getPairedSSID
methods.description: Retrieves SSID of the paired network.

methods.name: getPairedSSIDInfo
methods.description: Provides detailed info about the paired SSID.

methods.name: isPaired
methods.description: Checks if the device is paired with a network.

methods.name: getSupportedSecurityModes
methods.description: Lists supported security modes.

methods.name: retrieveSSID
methods.description: Fetches SSID based on input parameters.

methods.name: onWiFiStateChange
methods.description: Event handler for WiFi state changes.

methods.name: onAvailableSSIDs
methods.description: Event handler for available SSID listings.

methods.name: onWiFiSignalQualityChange
methods.description: Event handler for WiFi signal quality updates.

ctags.name: WiFiManager
ctags.pattern: /^        class WiFiManager : public PluginHost::IPlugin, public PluginHost::JSONRPC {$/
